ratios.quote: First lien net leverage ratio (1.05) to 1.00 (a) ≤ 2.25 to 1.00
Total net leverage ratio (0.03) to 1.00 (a) ≤ 3.50 to 1.00

parsed.notes: Negative actual ratios reflect cash available for general corporate purposes exceeding (secured) indebtedness. The 2026 Credit Agreement covenants (Total Net Leverage ≤3.50x, cash Interest Coverage ≥3.00x) became effective July 2, 2026, replacing the 2020 agreement's First Lien Net Leverage covenant; the company presented them pro forma as of June 30, 2026. Incremental-debt incurrence tests (e.g., 1.35x/1.50x first lien, 3.50x total, 2.00x FCCR, 2.00x secured) and margin-grid ratios were excluded.
